evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $36,000,000; attorneys' fees $7,200,000
The class-fund and fee amounts were included together in the proposals; they were not negotiated only after class relief had been agreed.
A $25 million fund plus a proportionate $6.25 million fee is a substantial but more realistic counter
Whitcombe Reyes LLP’s latest proposal has a $31.25 million total cash outlay, below Brightline’s $40 million cap and lower than Hargrove Lane LLP’s proposal.
Accepting it secures a binding settlement on the lower-cost terms.

summary: Class counsel included fees alongside class relief from the opening proposals, and Whitcombe described its revised fee as proportionate to the fund. Defense chose Whitcombe’s lower-cost proposal over Hargrove’s. The transcript does not show class counsel sacrificing class relief for its own fees, and the court declaration accurately describes the negotiation sequence.
